name: agent:ready
description: Spec complete (criteria, risk, verification). An agent may claim it.

name: agent:in-progress
description: Claimed by one session; the claim comment names branch and worktree.

name: agent:review
description: Draft PR open, gate run, awaiting Codex + human review.

name: agent:blocked
description: Gate failed after the retry budget, or a dependency is open.

name: agent:needs-human
description: Escalated: a human decision is required (docs/agents/policies.md).

name: agent:done
description: Merged and verified, or closed as won't do.

name: risk:low
description: Docs, tests, tooling, copy, isolated UI. No schema, authorization or camp screens.

name: risk:medium
description: Additive schema or behaviour outside the camp flows; new screens.

name: risk:high
description: Authorization, tenant isolation, sensitive data, camp flows, non-additive migrations.

name: exec:local-ok
description: Bounded, non-sensitive, reversible: a local model may pre-process or execute it.

name: needs:triage
description: New issue from the form; a human sets risk and readiness.

name: needs:decision
description: A product or architecture decision is open; not executable.

name: area:camp
description: The camp module (events) as used in production.
